summary: Implementation plan for minimal spinner-only player UI, ultra-fast first-frame startup (parallel chunk 0 + last chunk start, background link warm-up for next 2 chunks, progressive partial reads with 2-4 MB HTTP Range windows and progressive fallback, random-access AES-CTR keystream decryption with counter offset starting at 2 for 12-byte GCM IVs, shared HTTP/2 keep-alive OkHttp client, fast LoadControl thresholds, and background next-chunk prefetch within the 36 MB RAM window), and StreamTiming logcat instrumentation.
